UseCase.Question: Which ten artifacts currently planned for restoration, have the greatest aggregate public-exhibition exposure?
UseCase.Metric: Sum of daily adult and under-age visitors across every exhibition containing the artifact; restoration loan breaks ties.

Artifact.title: Coin Depicting a Ship's Prow
Artifact.Description: Coin Depicting a Ship's Prow. Creator or culture: Greek. Catalog date: after 307-243 BCE. Catalog medium: Bronze. Place of origin: Greece. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 9863 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/9863).

Artifact.title: Tetradrachm (Coin) Depicting the Hero Herakles with the Features of Alexander the Great
Artifact.Description: Tetradrachm (Coin) Depicting the Hero Herakles with the Features of Alexander the Great. Creator or culture: Greek; minted in Sidon, ancient Phoenicia. Catalog date: 336-323 BCE. Catalog medium: Silver. Place of origin: Syria. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 9696 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/9696).

Artifact.title: Amulet of Sekhmet
Artifact.Description: Amulet of Sekhmet. Creator or culture: Egyptian. Catalog date: Third Intermediate Period (about 1069–664 BCE). Catalog medium: Faience. Place of origin: Egypt. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 135838 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/135838).

Artifact.title: Canopic Jar of Amenhotep
Artifact.Description: Canopic Jar of Amenhotep. Creator or culture: Egyptian; Tomb A7, Dra Abu el-Naga, Thebes (now Luxor), Egypt. Catalog date: New Kingdom, Dynasty 18, reign of Amenhotep II (about 1427–1400 BCE). Catalog medium: Ceramic and pigment. Place of origin: Egypt. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 120266 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/120266).

Artifact.title: Shabti of Horu
Artifact.Description: Shabti of Horu. Creator or culture: Egyptian. Catalog date: Late Period, Dynasty 26 (664-525 BCE). Catalog medium: Faience. Place of origin: Egypt. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 120295 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/120295).

Artifact.title: Square Tile
Artifact.Description: Square Tile. Creator or culture: Morocco. Catalog date: Late 19th century. Catalog medium: Buff pottery with polychrome painting over white glaze. Place of origin: Morocco. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 16674 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/16674).

Artifact.title: Ruler Entertained by Dancers in a Paradise Garden
Artifact.Description: Ruler Entertained by Dancers in a Paradise Garden. Creator or culture: India Uttar Pradesh, Avadh. Catalog date: Late 18th century. Catalog medium: Opaque watercolor and gold on paper. Place of origin: India. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 76890 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/76890).

Artifact.title: Saddle
Artifact.Description: Saddle. Creator or culture: Central European, probably Bohemian. Catalog date: 1400-20. Catalog medium: Bone, staghorn, limewood, birchbark, rawhide, leather, and iron. Place of origin: Germany. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 106328 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/106328).

Artifact.title: Goblet
Artifact.Description: Goblet. Creator or culture: Late Roman or early Byzantine; coast of Syria or Palestine. Catalog date: 4th-5th century. Catalog medium: Glass, blown technique. Place of origin: Syria. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 65592 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/65592).

Artifact.title: Bottle
Artifact.Description: Bottle. Creator or culture: Roman or Byzantine; Eastern Mediterranean. Catalog date: 2nd-6th century. Catalog medium: Glass, blown technique. Place of origin: Mediterranean Region. Physical catalog record: Art Institute of Chicago object 61947 (https://www.artic.edu/artworks/61947).
